newsitem.title: USA: Dragon Systems unveils "natural" speech technology.
newsitem.headline: Dragon Systems unveils "natural" speech technology.

text.p: Dragon Systems Inc said Wednesday it unveiled its continuous speech recognition tool that is based on a person's natural speaking style.
The company said the dictation product, Dragon NaturallySpeaking, allows users to talk to their PC continuously and naturally without pauses.
Dragon provides speech products for both users and developers, as well as professional services for developers who want to incorporate natural speech into their software.

"This application is ideal for people who need to get their ideas and words rapidly into text, and want to be freed from the tyranny of the keyboard," said Jim Baker, the chief executive and co-founder of Dragon Systems.
Dragon develops and markets speech and language technology tools in multiple languages that allow people to create any text, issue commands and access data through speech.
